# Ayoola Damisile — Full-Stack Software Engineer & Systems Architect

> Official personal site and canonical entity home: https://www.damisile.name.ng/
> Knowledge Graph: Ayoola Damisile (/g/11ynvpcp11) • Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141703795

## Who
Ayoola Damisile (also: Damisile Ayoola, Ayoola Damisile Ayooluwa) is a Nigerian full-stack software engineer, systems architect, and open-source creator. Business Information Technology scholar at the Federal University of Technology Akure (FUTA). Lead Developer at LIGHTSUP ENERGY SOLUTIONS. IBM-certified Cybersecurity Architect (Oct 2026, credential 83Z8PYF1AZ8H) with Google AI Professional credentials. Open-source author of fixmcp and @damisile_ayoola/envvault on npm. Outside of software engineering, he is also an accomplished classical pianist, organist, and accompanist.
